summary: Comprehensive review completed. The PR implements grilling artifact approval flow for Grove issue #232. All acceptance criteria verified: AC1 (presents artifacts separately) and AC2 (creates files on approve). Four critical bugs were identified and fixed: 1) TypeScript grilling.ts had dead code and wrong file paths; 2) Go app.go used incorrect artifact reading logic ignoring errors; 3) Unused contextIdx field in modal; 4) Mismatched file paths between contract and implementation. After fixes, all 194 Go tests pass, all 14 TypeScript grilling tests pass, and code compiles cleanly.
reviewedAreas: Go TUI approval modal (internal/tui/modal/approve_grill.go: implements state machine for step-by-step artifact review with approve/reject actions)
TypeScript artifact generation (runtime/sandcastle/src/grilling.ts: generates context.md and spec.md from grilling transcript)
Go artifact reading in app.go (cmd/grove/app.go: detects completed workflows and presents approval modal)
TypeScript tests (runtime/sandcastle/src/grilling.test.ts: 14 tests covering R1-R3 acceptance criteria and A1 artifact generation)
Go TUI tests (internal/tui/modal/approve_grill_test.go: 26 tests covering AC1, AC2, and edge cases)

blockers.impact: Non-functional code - dead check (!readFileSync), unused import (readdirSync), fs.readdirSync() called before fs is imported
blockers.fix: Removed dead code, fixed import order to declare fs before use, simplified artifact reading logic to match contract paths

residualRisks: Grilling artifacts stored at repo root rather than issue-specific subdirectory - may cause conflicts if multiple grilling workflows run in same repository but this is acceptable for MVP
Artifact extraction heuristic in formatSpec() uses substring matching which may miss complex requirements - semantic parsing not implemented yet
fixes: runtime/sandcastle/src/grilling.ts: Removed !readFileSync check, removed unused readdirSync/existsSync imports, simplified artifact reading to match contract paths
cmd/grove/app.go: Fixed artifact reading to use correct paths (agent-flow/grilling/) instead of agent-flow/, added error handling for os.ReadFile
internal/tui/modal/approve_grill.go: Removed unused contextIdx field and increment logic from Update method
internal/tui/modal/approve_grill_test.go: Updated test fixtures to remove contextIdx field references
validation: make test - all 194 Go tests pass; npm run build && node --test dist/grilling.test.js in runtime/sandcastle - all 14 TypeScript tests pass
approvedReason: All acceptance criteria met after bug fixes. Implementation aligns with SANDCASTLE_JSON_CONTRACT specification. Test coverage comprehensive.
